correctness.rationale: The boundary of a 5-simplex is the unit sphere of the reduced six-letter permutation representation R_sgn plus complex weights 1,2. Modulo C3 it is the suspension of a free 3-fold lens quotient; the residual generator exchanges suspension cones with equator involution (z,w)->(-z,w), giving a mapping cone L(3;1,2)->L(3;2,2). The map induces an isomorphism on pi1=Z/3 and degree +2 on H3=Z, so van Kampen and the integral cone exact sequence yield pi1=pi2=0 and sole reduced H3=Z/2. Extending the Hurewicz generator to the degree-2 Moore cofiber and homological Whitehead gives M(Z/2,3) ≃ Σ²RP². Separately regenerated all barycentric flag-orbit cells (12,91,260,300,120), checked exact ∂²=0, and computed mod2/3/5/7 homology as diagnostics, not substitutes for the cone proof.
